slides.title: Are your meetings running and working?
slides.headline: Are your meetings running and working?
notes: At a quarterly from Q2 on, all five meetings should be running.
The five: daily huddle, weekly 1:1s, weekly leadership team meeting, monthly town hall and quarterly planning.
Rate every meeting that is running.
slides.support: Go down each meeting together, in about 10 minutes.
body: Running? Yes or no, with the date.
Working? Is the time, the length and the agenda right?
Write what to change, or no change.
Rate each meeting that is running: 0 below, 1 meets, 2 exceeds expectations.
